sentences.text: Wpcrl/1464/2023 on 19 October, 2023

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or
Sl. proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  WPCRL No.1464 of 2023  Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Ms. Disha Vashistha, Advocate holding brief of Mr. K.R. Gazi, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. M.A. Khan, A.G.A. for the State.

The challenge in this petition is made to FIR No. 516 of 2023,
under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, and 120-B IPC, Police Station SIDCUL, District Haridwar.
Heard.
Admit.
Learned G.A. takes notice for the respondent nos. 1 and 2.
Issue notices to the respondent no.3 returnable within four weeks.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Respondents may file counter affidavit within three weeks.
Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder affidavit, if any, be filed.
List this matter for final hearing on 01.03.2024.
Heard on Stay Application IA No.1 of 2023.
It is the case of the petitioner that similarly placed co-accused has already been protected by this Court in WPCRL No.1409 of 2023.
Having considered, till the next date of listing, as an interim measure, no coercive step shall be taken against the petitioner, provided he cooperates with the investigation.
Stay Application stands disposed of, accordingly.
